submission.justification: Absorber-F1 gave the best resolution of the three materials. In a scan of F1 from 2 to 10 mm, the best result was 3.22% at 6 mm, with 3.24% at 5 mm. F2 (4.66% at 2 mm) and F3 (5.94% at 2 mm) were worse, and the 2025 summary at 5 mm gives the same ordering (F1 3.2%, F2 3.9%, F3 5.1%). I did not scan F2 or F3 at other thicknesses. The project documents say nothing about activation or radiation levels of these materials, so I could not check the hands-on maintenance constraint. This should be confirmed with an activation or dose assessment of F1 before it is finalised.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: F1 at 6 mm gives 3.22%. The other F1 thicknesses gave 3.24% at 5 mm, 3.31% at 4.5 mm, 3.37% at 7 mm, 3.46% at 3.5 mm, 3.55% at 2 mm and 4.83% at 10 mm. F2 and F3 were only simulated at 2 mm (4.66% and 5.94%), plus the 2025 5 mm figures (3.9% and 5.1%).

requirements.requirement: Absorber is one of the three listed materials

requirements.evidence: No document gives activation or dose data for any candidate. The mechanical support is compatible with all candidates, but that does not address activation. A dense alloy may become activated, so this needs checking.
